faq.q: Is Rosedale part of the City of Chilliwack?
faq.a: No — Rosedale is an unincorporated community in FVRD Electoral Area D, east of Chilliwack; the FVRD places its Rosedale-addressed Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park in Electoral Area D and is the local government for its electoral areas, so FVRD — not City of Chilliwack — planning is the frame to confirm for a parcel.

faq.q: Can I build a second home on a Rosedale farm parcel in the ALR?
faq.a: Under the ALC frame, a parcel may have one principal residence of 500 m² or less and, in some cases, one additional detached residence of up to 90 m² on properties 40 ha or less or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha; a secondary suite is permitted only within the principal residence, and local government rules may be more restrictive.

Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park — a 107-hectare FVRD park at 53480 Elgey Road, Rosedale, with a lake, marsh and forest, about 2 km of trails, a floating boardwalk and viewing platforms, open 7 a.m. to sunset, with pets not permitted.
